issues.issue: P1 error: the top third of the page is empty, with 'Making clips' starting about 225 px down, so the first thing on screen is blank paper rather than the failure.

P1 editor: the bordered 'Download MP4' button sits one gap directly above the solid black 'Apply changes' in the same right column, so the destructive-to-export action and the save action read at nearly the same weight.
P1 cliplist: the six clip rows carry no accept, reject or hover control of their own, so the only place to act is the 'Review 6 clips' button in the header and the list itself reads as navigation.
P2 cliplist: about 150 px of empty black sits between the 'Auto headline' banner and the first row of clip cards, pushing the clips low on the screen for no reason.
P2 cliplist: the left rail is seven unlabeled icons (home, grid, folder, calendar, bars, link, tray) with no tooltip or text on screen, so the navigation cannot be read without hovering.
P2 editor: the transcript is set in a monospaced face with yellow and green highlighted words and inline '0.58s' timestamps, so the copy, the timings and the keywords all shout at the same size.
P3 cliplist: the date and play-count columns do not line up row to row, because the metadata pills push them (ENG-139's 'Dec 2023' sits roughly 250 px left of ENG-416's 'Jun 5').
P3 cliplist: the sidebar shows 'Projects' and 'Views' twice, once under Workspace and once under Your teams, with identical labels and icons, so the two groups cannot be told apart.
P3 editor: nothing on the open item reads as the main action; the 'Done' state chip, star, link icon and '...' all carry the same weight and the only affordance is the small '+' in the top bar.
P4 cliplist: the 'Create project' tile is a full-width cyan-to-teal gradient that is the brightest surface on the screen, so the project thumbnails below it look flat and grayed out by comparison.

P4 cliplist: each of the seven 'More tools' tiles floats a small blue AI badge above its icon at a different offset, and 'Long video to shorts' wraps to two lines while 'AI image' does not, so the labels share no baseline.

P4 editor: the Details panel prints a raw path ('C:/Users/Admin/Desktop/CapCut Drafts/1025 (1)') at the same size and weight as 'Ratio: Original', so one value wraps and the rest are single short lines.
P5 cliplist: the whole table sits at low contrast, with row names in mid gray on a gray page and the Name/Duration/Created headers barely darker than the background, so the screen reads as disabled.

P5 cliplist: the 24 px leading thumbnail is a globe on some rows, a camera on others and a frame grab on others, so the one column meant to identify each item is the least consistent thing in the row.

P5 editor: 'Eye Contact', 'Center active speaker', 'Green screen', 'Automatic multicam' and 'Blur speaker background' are greyed in the AI Tools panel with no reason on screen, so a third of the panel looks broken rather than gated.
P6 cliplist: three raw identifiers ('d591db2c-0a82-482e-a8c8-5f93768b9a24' and two more) sit unstyled between the tab row and the 'Tracks' heading with no field label or container.

P6 cliplist: 'Export all' carries a thick white outline that makes it the loudest control on the page, louder than the purple 'Create' button beside it, and five per-row 'Download' buttons repeat at full weight below.
P6 editor: the 'Sound Effects' tab is wrapped in a white rounded outline instead of the plain underline 'Audio'/'Music' tabs use, so the tab family breaks inside the Audio panel.

notes: Only P1 has an error screen, so empty/error for P2-P6 was scored from their cliplist and editor screens alone. P3's two screens are an issue tracker (list, then record detail) and P4's is a video-editor home plus classic editor, so those two were judged on craft rather than as clip-review tools.
